premise.claim: Dependabot security update: scikit-learn 1.4.0 pinned by samples/vineyard/requirements.txt is affected by a published advisory fixed in 1.5.0 (GHSA-jw8x-6495-233v / CVE-2024-5206).
premise.reportedComponent: samples/vineyard sample images (python:3.10, pip hash-locked requirements.txt)
premise.evidence: GitHub Advisory API: GHSA-jw8x-6495-233v, pip:scikit-learn, vulnerable '< 1.5.0', first_patched_version 1.5.0, severity medium. See results/head/P0.log. Note: the vulnerable component (TfidfVectorizer) is not used by the sample scripts, so this is dependency hygiene, not an active exploit fix.

findings.note: OPEN on e782cc7d: header regeneration command still pins scikit-learn==1.4.0 while the file pins 1.5.0. Fails on head, passes on base -> introduced by this PR. Fix = update the version literal in the header printf command.
Acceptance contract, passing on head: hash set for the scikit-learn entry exactly equals the PyPI digest set for the pinned version and covers cp310 manylinux x86_64/aarch64.
Acceptance contract, passing on head and base: the Dockerfile pip command resolves hash-locked on python 3.10; the sklearn wheel resolves+hash-verifies for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64.
Acceptance contract, passing on head and base with bit-identical MSE (45484148750.70735): the bump does not change the sample's behavior.

PRE-EXISTING breakage, fails identically on base and head: pinned setuptools 84.x ships no pkg_resources, so 'import vineyard' fails in the sample images. Not introduced by this PR; do not hold the PR for it. Flips to pass when the sample pins a compatible setuptools or vineyard drops pkg_resources.

liveNote: No live layer: the change only affects manually built sample images (samples/vineyard/Makefile); no cluster/controller behavior. The vineyard IPC path (with_vineyard=True) additionally needs a live vineyard server and is out of scope; it is already unreachable at base because of the C4 import breakage.
